subject.title: fix(gateway): keep hot reload subsystems consistent during channel deferral

question: Is runtime config plus hooks and cron the intended atomic hot-reload boundary, with plugin, Gmail, MCP, and channel recovery remaining best-effort?
rationale: No discrete patch defect is proven, but the change formalizes a lifecycle boundary across external operations whose side effects cannot all be reversed; repository policy requires area-owner judgment for that behavior contract.

options.title: Accept bounded transaction
options.body: Rebase and merge after refreshed proof if a gateway lifecycle owner confirms runtime config plus hooks and cron as the atomic boundary and external recovery as best-effort.

options.title: Require broader recovery
options.body: Hold the PR until plugin, Gmail, MCP, and partial channel failures receive explicit restoration semantics and focused coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded transaction
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge after refreshed proof if a gateway lifecycle owner confirms runtime config plus hooks and cron as the atomic boundary and external recovery as best-effort.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work most directly owns the neighboring deferred reload lifecycle and restart-cancellation invariants affected here.
